-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "POST /save htmx(marshalJSON(Save(ctx, form)))" -}}
{{- if .Err -}}<p>save failed: {{ .Err }}</p>{{- else -}}{{ .HXTrigger "saved" }}discarded{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"errors"
	"html/template"
	"net/url"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Saved struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

type Server struct{}

// Save responds JSON but still steers the htmx client: the define body
// executes against HTMXTemplateData, so the HX-Trigger header reaches the
// JSON success response, and a method error falls back to the rendered HTML.
func (Server) Save(_ context.Context, form url.Values) (Saved, error) {
	name := form.Get("name")
	if name == "" {
		return Saved{}, errors.New("name is required")
	}
	return Saved{Name: name}, nil
}
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func post(t *testing.T, mux *http.ServeMux, body string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	t.Helper()
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/save", strings.NewReader(body))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	return rec
}

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	t.Run("JSON success carries the HX header", func(t *testing.T) {
		rec := post(t, mux, "name=ada")
		if got, want := rec.Header().Get("Content-Type"), "application/json"; got != want {
			t.Errorf("Content-Type = %q, want %q", got, want)
		}
		if got, want := rec.Header().Get("HX-Trigger"), "saved"; got != want {
			t.Errorf("HX-Trigger = %q, want %q", got, want)
		}
		if want := `{"name":"ada"}`; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("method error falls back to rendered HTML", func(t *testing.T) {
		rec := post(t, mux, "")
		if !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), "save failed: name is required") {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want the rendered error branch", rec.Body.String())
		}
		if ct := rec.Header().Get("Content-Type"); !strings.HasPrefix(ct, "text/html") {
			t.Errorf("Content-Type = %q, want text/html for the fallback", ct)
		}
	})
}
